semiconductor_relevance: High — Kyowa specializes in precision small-diameter tools that are essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Kyowa provides precision micro tools specifically designed for machining applications in the semiconductor industry. Their extensive lineup includes specialized drills made from PCD and cBN materials, optimized for drilling silicon and ceramics, which are critical in semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Special PCD drills for silicon and ceramics machining
Oil hole carbide drills with DLC and AlCrN coatings
